name: Jiangsu JieJie Microelectronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu JieJie Microelectronics Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, design, production, and sale of power semiconductor chips and devices in China and internationally. It offers uni-directional and bi-directional thyristors; transient voltage and thyristor surge suppresso, TVS diode array, sidac, zener and small switching diodes, small signal transistor, varistor, and ceramic gas discharge tube; and automotive, low and medium-voltage, and high-voltage MOSFETs. The company also provides rectifier diodes and bridge rectifier; power modules and components; opto-coupler; power IC; and IGBT products.
